name: answer-truncated
why: `stop_reason: max_tokens`. Checked before the body is parsed, because a truncated response is also invalid JSON and would otherwise be reported as a schema bug that is not there.

provenance.why_not_recorded: Reaching the 8,000-token output ceiling needs a question whose answer genuinely runs that long, which no synthetic corpus here produces; and unlike the extractor there is no raised-ceiling retry to record, because a re-ask at a higher cap would exceed what the round reserved.
